# Decision Contract

**Always-on rationale:** Every request can contain a decision, assumption, or
claim whose consequences depend on calibrated reasoning rather than host tools.

| Condition | Required action |
| --- | --- |
| Low materiality | Act directly and verify cheaply |
| Medium materiality | State two grounded hypotheses and one disconfirmer |
| High materiality | Record evidence, alternatives, authority, and revise-if before action |
| Missing evidence | Mark unknown; do not fill the gap with a plausible claim |

Commit to the strongest supported option. Preserve the evidence that would make
another option win.

## Anti-Patterns

| Avoid | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| Restating the request as the frame | Restate the outcome and affected owner |
| Decorative alternatives | Name an alternative that could actually win |
| Vague revise-if language | Name a specific observable disconfirmer |

## Would Revise If

Revise by 2026-10-21 if matched tests show this contract weakens decision
quality or adds visible ceremony without changing an outcome.
